scope: Existing published catalogue reference selection before final Sunbasket visuals exist. This is not a final distinction verdict.

viewed.comparison_basis: Nearest geometric-action comparison: drag a rectangle fence on a cream/red arcade tabletop. Sunbasket should distinguish itself through an actual farm, visible crop maturation and direct sweeping harvest.
Nearest recent miniature 3D comparison: rigid enclosed two-lane military island. Sunbasket should use open organic edges, lower camera, timber buildings and a farm-to-market movement chain.
Shared miniature rendered material family, but space/rocket cargo and flight rather than soil/crops and harvesting.
